mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM tab_admin a INNER JOIN tab_admin_role ar ON ar.admin_id = a.id INNER JOIN tab_role r ON r.id = ar.role_id AND r.status = 2000 INNER JOIN tab_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN tab_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.status = 2000 WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status = 2000
